text: For a new order, a customer may choose one of her own earlier orders as its blueprint.
review: Preserves customer ownership, blueprint semantics, and the possibility rather than obligation to reuse.

text: An assembled order must not be canceled; cancellation is permitted only before assembly has finished.
review: Preserves the assembly-completion cutoff and the prohibition after that point.

text: As soon as a packing clerk completes assembly of an order, send the record of its expected payment to the existing payment system.
review: Preserves actor, completion trigger, expected-payment record, and external destination.

text: Each night, the system prints the manager's business report automatically for the selected day's orders.
review: Preserves automatic nightly printing, manager audience, and orders of a given day.
